correctness.rationale: The exact cubic local equation has a nonzero quadratic w^2 tangent term and a nonzero t^3 term, giving an A2 branch. A tangent-component argument proves integrality; coordinate restrictions have separable discriminant (ab)^2-(a+b)^3 and give nine simple Kummer branch points. Independent square classes establish a connected degree-four cover, and Riemann--Hurwitz gives genus six. The only four singularities are etale pullbacks of the cubic cusp. The exact verifier enumerates all rational points over F3 and F9 on all admissible parameters without pretending to prove the closure statement.

value.rationale: The characteristic-three boundary is excluded from the published arithmetic treatment of a naturally motivated sextic family. An open family of geometric integral four-cuspidal plane sextics, a connected genus-six Kummer normalization, and an explicit nine-point branch divisor together explain the geometric degeneration and preserve rational-point counting across finite extensions. This is a structural classification of a natural missing-characteristic regime, not a trivial parameter substitution.
